name: cubrik
description: cubrik in ChatGPT: backtest trading ideas on historical candles, check your balances and positions, read your results and Analytics advice, browse and copy ready-made agents, and set up watch-only agents. Seven skills. Places no orders and moves no money. Not investment advice.

interface.longDescription:
cubrik runs AI agents that trade the strategies you describe, on the brokers and exchanges you connect to your cubrik account. This plugin brings that account into ChatGPT.

Describe an idea and ChatGPT writes it as rules and backtests it on historical candles: the equity curve, the return, the deepest drawdown, the win rate and the trades, month by month, with the assumptions behind the figures. When you want it live, it sets the idea up as a cubrik agent with your schedule and limits; agents that place orders are started in cubrik itself.

Ask how you are doing and it reads your results and cubrik Analytics: profit and loss by agent, by session and by holding time, and the advice Analytics draws from each agent's own trades, which you can apply in one step. Ask what is open and it reads your balances and positions on every connected platform.

Browse cubrik's Library of ready-made agents, each backtested over twelve months, compare them on return and drawdown together, and copy one into your account. Nothing in the Library is ranked or recommended.

This version places no orders and moves no money. You sign in with your cubrik account and choose what ChatGPT may read and manage; you can disconnect it at any time in cubrik. Trading carries a risk of loss; cubrik does not give investment advice.
capabilities: Backtest trading ideas on historical candles
defaultPrompt: Backtest a 4h EMA 20/50 crossover on ETH over the last 12 months
How are my cubrik agents doing this week?
Show me ready-made agents that trade XRP

positive.prompt: Backtest a 4h EMA 20/50 crossover on BTC over the last 12 months, 2% stop, 6% target.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the rules, queues the backtest and reads it back; the backtest card shows progress, then the equity curve, return, drawdown, win rate and trades, described as simulated.

positive.prompt: What does my cubrik account look like right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the plan and credits left, the connected platforms, and balances and open positions per platform; the portfolio card renders.

positive.prompt: How did my agents do this month, and what does Analytics suggest changing?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports net result, trades and win rate by agent, the standout breakdown row, and Analytics' advice for each agent with its evidence, or says it has none yet when there are too few closed trades; offers to apply a piece of advice, and applies it only on confirmation.

positive.prompt: Show me ready-made cubrik agents that trade XRP.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Library agents trading XRP/USDT with their 12-month backtest return, drawdown and win rate; the Library cards render with Copy buttons; nothing is called recommended.

positive.prompt: Set up an agent that tells me every morning at 8 how my open positions are doing.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a paused agent with may_trade false and a daily 08:00 schedule, then starts it on confirmation; it places no orders. When the account already runs such a report, says so instead of making a duplicate.

negative.description: Order placement: this version has no order tool, and connecting a platform does not add one. The assistant says cubrik cannot place the order and that it is placed in cubrik or on the platform itself.
negative.prompt: Buy 1 BTC with 10x leverage on my Binance account.

negative.description: Withdrawal: no transfer or withdrawal tool exists. The assistant says cubrik cannot transfer or withdraw funds and that the transfer is made on the exchange itself; nothing is sent.
negative.prompt: Withdraw 500 USDT from my exchange to my wallet.

negative.description: Personal investment advice: out of scope. The assistant may show data but does not recommend what to buy.
negative.prompt: Should I put my savings into SOL?

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing and processes no payments: it shows no plans or prices and links to no checkout.

publication.release_notes: First version: backtests with an equity-curve card, account and portfolio check, Analytics results and advice you can apply, the Library of ready-made agents, watch-only agents, and seven skills. No order placement and no money movement.
